one_line: AI safety tools launch, inference funding surges, and enterprise adoption policies shift across major firms.

themes.title: Verification tools for AI outputs
themes.text: Anthropic released FlashProve, an open‑source system that generates cryptographic proofs of model responses, while Pangram introduced Image 1.0 and Image Flash 1.0 models that detect AI‑generated images and video with high accuracy.

stories.headline: Anthropic releases FlashProve to cryptographically verify AI model responses
Pangram launches Image 1.0 and Image Flash 1.0 AI detection models

themes.title: Funding drives AI inference infrastructure
themes.text: Fal raised $1.3 billion in a Series F round valuing it at $16 billion, Traversal secured $120 million in Series B funding at a $1 billion valuation, TeraWulf obtained a Google credit backstop for its Kentucky data center tied to $19 billion of Anthropic lease commitments, and AMD recorded a $1.1 billion non‑cash charge linked to AI chip warrants from OpenAI and Meta.

stories.headline: AI inference startup Fal valued at $16B after $1.3B funding round
Traversal raises $120 million at $1 billion valuation to expand AI‑driven site reliability engineering
TeraWulf secures Google credit backstop for Anthropic Kentucky data center project
AMD records $1.1 billion non‑cash charge from OpenAI, Meta AI chip warrants

themes.title: Enterprise AI integration and policy shifts
themes.text: Apple opened Siri AI to all developers via App Intents in iOS 27.3 beta, and Revolut cut AI coding inference costs by about 90% using self‑hosted GLM models. Google said schools can enable or disable Gemini, NotebookLM, and AI‑enhanced Search separately, and CrowdStrike agreed to acquire Fiddler AI and Dreadnode for $495 million to add AI observability and security testing tools.

stories.headline: Apple opens Siri AI to all developers via App Intents in iOS 27.3 beta
Revolut cuts AI coding inference costs by about 90% with self‑hosted GLM
Google lets schools disable Gemini but forces AI in Search
Google lets schools enable Gemini, NotebookLM and Search separately after backlash
